tgam_init.message0: Initialize TGAM %1 serial port %2 RX pin %3 TX pin %4 baud rate %5
tgam_init.tooltip: Initialize the TGAM module on the selected serial port (default baud 57600); ESP32 Serial1/Serial2 accept RX/TX pins, on Arduino UNO choose Serial (pins 0/1)

tgam_signal_quality.tooltip: Returns signal quality (0=best, higher means noisier, 200=no contact) from the last valid packet

tgam_attention.tooltip: Returns attention value (0-100) from the last valid packet

tgam_meditation.tooltip: Returns meditation value (0-100) from the last valid packet

tgam_signal_good.tooltip: Returns true when signal quality is 0, meaning good electrode contact

tgam_has_new_data.tooltip: Returns true when a checksum-valid big packet was just parsed in this loop
